mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, user_id AS userId, summary_text AS summaryText, covered_from_index AS coveredFromIndex, covered_to_index AS coveredToIndex, token_count AS tokenCount, status, model_name AS modelName, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_session_summary WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY covered_to_index DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session_summary SET status = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 1
